channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: We built a desktop AI assistant you can train by doing the task once
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An AI agent ran a Reddit account on a real desktop through the W3BS Agentic Desktop Layer. W3BS Training lets you record a task once so the agent learns how you do it.

item.title: A/B testing on w3bs.org, and OpenABTest 0.2
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Free hosted A/B testing on w3bs.org with sticky server-side assignment and no automatic winners, plus OpenABTest 0.2 goal conversions.

item.title: DiskPush 0.13 and 0.14: database backups and S3 buckets
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush now dumps Postgres, Supabase, MySQL and SQLite to verified, tagged backups, and pushes to any S3-compatible bucket like it was a server.

item.title: Are we all just going to be human CAPTCHA solvers?
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: I've automated nearly my whole business with the w3bs.org Agentic Desktop Layer, driven from the moshcode CLI. What my agents still stop and wait for me on is mostly proving I'm human. A few questions about what that means.

item.title: pit.world: private search, and a doorway to the Moshpit network
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A search engine that keeps no logs, sets no cookies and works without JavaScript, and that also searches the Moshpit network: 17,609 endings outside ICANN's root.

item.title: CoinPay invoicing: reminders, late fees, a client portal and time tracking
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CoinPay invoices now send scheduled reminders, charge late fees, carry your branding, and come with a client portal, projects, time tracking and an AR aging report.

item.title: CoinPay invoices now have line items, tax and discounts
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CoinPay invoices now carry line items, per-line tax, discounts and a saved catalog of products and tax rates.

item.title: W3BS Training: teach agents by doing the task yourself
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Record a task from the desktop tray, review every capture, and let one agent you choose retrieve the approved examples over MCP.

item.title: Agentic Desktop Layer 0.2: your agents on your real desktop, on Linux, macOS and Windows
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Version 0.2 lets Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex drive your real desktop on Linux, macOS and Windows, starting disabled, behind a switch you control.

item.title: The W3BS community board is open
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: W3BS now has a public forum at w3bs.org/bbs for desktop agents, the w3bs CLI and packages, MCP tooling and the open spec drafts.
